Title: Restless Legs at Night? It Could Be Low Iron

Description:
If your legs won't stay still at night, it might not be restlessness — restless legs syndrome affects nearly 1 in 10 American adults, and low iron is one of the most common triggers behind it.

A few everyday habits can quietly block the iron you're already eating: acid reducers like omeprazole, zinc supplements taken at the wrong time, and red wine with dinner. None of them mean you have to cut anything out completely — just space them out.

Watch the video for exactly how to time them.
